player.thinkText: The board is frozen: calculate the entire line. Click “I'm ready” when you've worked it out; you will play your moves, your opponent will reply by themselves.
player.thinkHidden: The board is frozen: calculate the line all the way to the end, for both sides.
player.answerText: Play your moves in one go; your opponent replies by themselves: 3 seconds per move.
player.wrongText: The solution is replayed on the board.
player.lateText: Time to play has run out.
player.solveText: Play your moves; your opponent replies. Remember the entire line.
player.replayText: From memory: replay the entire line in one go, for both sides, 3 seconds per ply.

kinds.reply: Your first move has been played. What is your opponent's best reply?
kinds.two_replies: Your opponent has only two replies to your first move: calculate a line against each. Click “I'm ready” when you've worked them out.
kinds.defence: Your opponent is threatening checkmate. Calculate the line that prevents it. Click “I'm ready” when you've worked it out.
kinds.intermezzo: Your opponent will reply with a check. Calculate the line that still wins. Click “I'm ready” when you've worked it out.
kinds.combo: Three forced moves, only one combination works. Choose it, then play the continuation: your opponent replies by themselves.
kinds.advocate: Suggest your move, then play devil's advocate: play your opponent's best reply, followed by your continuation, all in one go. Click “I'm ready” when you have the entire line.

player.firstLineText: First line: your move, one of the two replies played for you, then your continuation. 3 seconds per move.
player.secondLineText: Second line: the other reply is played; continue. 3 seconds per move.
player.preparing: The engine is preparing the replies…
player.engineDown: Engine unavailable: only the solution line can be judged correct.
player.mistakeSecond: Mistake at ply {n} of the second line
player.preparingCombos: The engine is preparing the combinations…

metronome.right: Tick… tock… You're still keeping the beat.
metronome.wrong: Ha! Wrong beat. The streak starts over.
metronome.late: Too slow: you lost the rhythm.

moods.neutral: Tick, tock. Calculate all the way to checkmate: I won't tell you how many moves it takes.
moods.doubt: You're hesitating… but the beat won't wait.
moods.sadness: Three in a row… you're throwing off my rhythm.
moods.anger: Six! I'm out of tune, and I'm speeding up.
moods.focus: The home stretch. Don't fall a beat behind.
moods.anxiety: Just one more, and the beat is yours…
moods.surprise: Already? You're calculating faster than my tempo.
moods.pride: My rhythm got the better of you.

question.where: At the end of the line, where is the {piece}?
question.what: At the end of the line, what is on {square}?

advocate.right: Objection overruled: your idea held up, and you defended it to the end.
advocate.wrong: I told you so: your idea doesn't stand up to scrutiny.
advocate.late: Your time to argue has run out.
advocate.refutedFound: Your idea didn't hold up, but you found the refutation.
advocate.refutedMissed: Your idea didn't hold up, and your opponent had a better reply than the one you gave them.
advocate.tooKind: Your idea held up, but you were too lenient as a lawyer: your opponent had a better reply.
